title: Runtime jobs
description: Jobs run cyclically by the runtime service, stored at <data root>/_runtime/jobs.json. A loop_kpi job computes live loop KPIs from Connector.read_live samples over a rolling window; anomaly_scan jobs are accepted from Phase 1, their execution lands in a later phase (the runtime marks them 'unsupported' until then). A tuning_review job reviews the applied tuning proposals of the loops named in 'loops' (ADR 014 section 5): it reads <data root>/_tuning/proposals and the runtime history, and needs no window_s.

jobs.description: The jobs of the deployment; empty when nothing is deployed.

kind.description: What the job computes. loop_kpi: live KPI of the site loops named in 'loops'; anomaly_scan: live anomaly scan over the tags named in 'tags'; tuning_review: KPI before/after review of applied tuning proposals of the loops named in 'loops'.

source.description: Id of an entry in the site's sources; live values are read from that source.

loops.description: Ids of entries in the site's loops; required for loop_kpi jobs.

tags.description: Ids of entries in the site's tags; required for anomaly_scan jobs.

period_s.description: How often the job samples the source, in seconds.

window_s.description: Length of the rolling window the KPI is computed on, in seconds. Required for every kind except tuning_review, which derives its windows from the proposal's process model.

enabled.description: Whether the runtime runs the job; the GUI start/stop acts on this flag.
